COMMON_STEPS.title: One number, two places
COMMON_STEPS.text: The same data point can show a different number on two pages, because each counts within its own department or group: Development counts the Development department, QA the bugs and feedback, KPI the whole company, Insights the period you chose. Click any number to see exactly which tasks it counts.

COMMON_STEPS.title: The menu
COMMON_STEPS.text: Every page, by module (Dashboard, Insights, Employees, Integration). The module of the page you are on is highlighted and open; click another module to open it. Drag ⠿ to put modules in your order, and pages within their own module. Hover the icons to open the menu; click ☰ to pin it open.

COMMON_STEPS.title: Filters
COMMON_STEPS.text: Project, assignee, tag and date range narrow every number on the tab. Reset filters clears them. The "i" icons say exactly what each number counts.
COMMON_STEPS.member: Project, assignee, tag and date range narrow every number on the tab, within your own tasks. The "i" icons say exactly what each number counts.

COMMON_STEPS.title: Alerts
COMMON_STEPS.text: The bell counts overdue tasks and tasks stuck over 5 days in one stage. Click it for the list and jump to the tasks.

COMMON_STEPS.title: Live
COMMON_STEPS.text: Live means changes in Bitrix24 reach the dashboard within seconds; numbers refresh by themselves. Offline means the connection dropped and it is reconnecting.

COMMON_STEPS.title: Page tools
COMMON_STEPS.text: On the right: Customise (choose the tiles and cards to show), the guided tour of this page, the PDF guides, Export page (every data point on the page as one Excel workbook or PDF), reading tours aloud, and resetting the layout. Hover any icon for its name. Each data point also has a small toolbar on hover: ⠿ to move it, ? to explain it, the eye to hide it. Tables have Columns (choose and order them) and ⠿ on each row to put rows in your own order.

COMMON_STEPS.title: Your profile
COMMON_STEPS.text: Your name and role, the theme (Light, Dark, System), live-update toasts, Reset layout, this tour (replay, voice on or off) and Sign out. You are signed out 3 days after signing in.

dev.title: All, Dev or Issues
dev.text: Development department only. Dev = development tasks, Issues = bugs and feedback, All = both. It changes every tile, card and list on this page (they glow now).

dev.title: Projects
dev.text: Every project active in Bitrix24 whose owner is in the Development or QA Testing department, or a PM (fixed: the switch and filters do not change it; only the Project filter narrows it) = Active + Silent + Hold. Hold: every unfinished task is in On Hold. Active: open tasks and a task changed or moved in the last 30 days (bulk changes left out). Silent: the rest (no open task, or no activity for 30 days). Click for Projects at work, most active this week first, then the earliest deadline: open a project for who works on it. Its Day / Week / Month switch sets Done (previous period), Overdue (this period) and Spill (previous period).

dev.title: Total
dev.text: All tasks in the filters for the switch (Dev, Issues or both), Development department only. Under the number: the split into Dev and Issues (or Bug and Feedback). Click any count to list those tasks below.
dev.member: Your tasks (assigned to you or created by you) for the switch. Click any count to list those tasks below.

dev.title: Pending
dev.text: Behind QA Backlog and not on hold: To do, In progress, Pushed to Master, Merged to Development, Pending for QA, Issue Raised. A testing or re-testing task in Issue Raised is not pending. Unassigned: those of them nobody has picked up yet (the placeholder assignee); click to list them. Click any count to list those tasks below.

dev.title: On hold
dev.text: In On Hold: neither pending nor completed. Pending + completed + on hold = total.

dev.title: Ready to deploy
dev.text: In the Done stage, ready to go live. Then Deployed: in the LIVE stage.

dev.title: Overdue
dev.text: Pending, not On Hold, and the deadline has passed. The first number to act on each day.

dev.title: Done today
dev.text: Reached QA Backlog for the first time today (IST).

dev.title: Tasks in hand
dev.text: Pending tasks (behind QA Backlog, not on hold) whose deadline is still ahead (IST). Under it, when they are planned: tomorrow, the rest of this week, the rest of this month, next week, next month. The parts overlap (tomorrow is also in the rest of the week), so they do not add up. Overdue and no-deadline tasks are not in hand. Click the tile for the planner: day, week or month columns per person (with the projects they work on) or per project (with who works on it), overdue first in red.

dev.title: Tasks in hand by assignee
dev.text: Pending tasks with the deadline ahead, per assignee or project. The chart shows the window picked above it (All, Tomorrow, Rest of week, Rest of month, Next week, Next month); the table shows every window. A bar or count opens those tasks; a name sets the filter.

dev.title: Per person or project
dev.text: Per person or project. Done = sent to QA (QA Backlog to LIVE). Comp. today = reached QA Backlog today. Switch Assignee / Project at the top. Every count opens its tasks. Click the title to focus it in the centre; drag ⠿ at the top to move it.

dev.title: Pending vs Done
dev.text: Pending vs completed (QA Backlog, In QA, Done, LIVE) per person or project, top 15 by total. Tooltip splits Dev / Issues (Bug / Feedback on Issues). Click a bar to open those tasks.

dev.title: Task ageing
dev.text: Open tasks by days past deadline. On Hold counts here but not as Overdue. The darker the red, the later. Chart or Table at the top.

dev.title: On-time ranking
dev.text: Tasks sent to QA with a deadline. Ranked by on-time %, then average days early. Fewer than 3: not ranked.

dev.title: Tasks by stage
dev.text: Tasks per Kanban stage; the colour bar shows each stage total. The red part of a cell is overdue. Click a cell for those tasks.

dev.title: Task lists
dev.text: Due today, Overdue, All tasks and Alert details open here. Clicking any number above opens All tasks narrowed to it. In a list: click a cell to change stage, status or tags (and more for leads), tick rows for bulk edit, and export to Excel.
dev.member: Due today, Overdue, All tasks and Alert details open here. Clicking any number above opens All tasks narrowed to it. In a list you can change stage, status and tags of your tasks, tick rows for bulk edit, and export to Excel.

qa.title: Issues filed
qa.text: Every task tagged bug or feedback in the filters, whoever it is assigned to. Bug and Feedback under the number. Click any count to list those tasks below.
qa.member: Bugs and feedback assigned to you or filed by you. Click any count to list those tasks below.

qa.title: Tasks in hand
qa.text: The QA Testing team's pending testing tasks whose deadline is still ahead (IST), by when they are planned: tomorrow, the rest of this week, the rest of this month, next week, next month. The parts overlap, so they do not add up. Click the tile for the planner: day, week or month columns per person (with the projects they work on) or per project (with who works on it), overdue first in red.

qa.title: Tasks in hand by assignee
qa.text: The testing team's pending tasks with the deadline ahead, per assignee or project. The chart shows the window picked above it; the table shows every window. A bar or count opens those tasks; a name sets the filter.

qa.title: Open / pending
qa.text: Open = pending: any stage behind QA Backlog except On Hold (Issue Raised included). Resolved = QA Backlog, In QA, Done or LIVE. On Hold is its own tile. The ring shows the resolved %. Unassigned: those of them nobody has picked up yet (the placeholder assignee); click to list them. Click the tile for the open issues by project: open a project for who filed them, and a creator for who has them, each with Pending and Overdue.

qa.title: On hold
qa.text: In On Hold: neither pending nor completed. Pending + completed + on hold = total.

qa.title: Last filed and resolved
qa.text: Latest day an issue was created, and how many that day. Click for that day by project: open a project for who filed its issues (bug and feedback), and a creator for who they went to. Next to it, Last resolved: Latest day issues were pushed to QA Backlog (a fix handed to QA), and how many that day.

qa.title: Rework
qa.text: Issues QA sent back after testing: from QA Backlog, In QA or Done to Issue Raised, To do or In progress. Stage flow only.

qa.title: Retesting awaited
qa.text: Every task waiting for QA: in QA Backlog or In QA, split into dev tasks and issues (bug or feedback). The QA team's queue.

qa.title: Issues by person
qa.text: Open vs resolved, each split into bug and feedback (or the reverse), per person or project. Table: the assignee-wise table. Click the title to focus it in the centre; drag ⠿ at the top to move it.

qa.title: Rework by developer
qa.text: QA send-backs per person or project, split into bug and feedback, and the % of their issues sent back. First Issue Raised to To do is not counted.

qa.title: Testing tasks
qa.text: Tasks tagged testing or re-testing, or assigned to QA Testing. Late = pending past deadline. A testing or re-testing task in Issue Raised is "Issue raised": not pending, never late.

qa.title: Waiting for retest
qa.text: Issues in QA Backlog or In QA, by who filed them. Oldest = days waiting.

qa.title: Retest queue by person
qa.text: Tasks and issues in QA Backlog and In QA per assignee or project. Every number opens its tasks.

qa.title: Issue trend
qa.text: Last 7 days (IST): bugs and feedback filed (created, light) and resolved (pushed to QA Backlog that day, dark). Pick one assignee or project, or see all. Click a point for that day's issues.

qa.title: Issue ageing
qa.text: Open issues by days past deadline (same as task ageing). On Hold counts here.

qa.title: Issues by stage
qa.text: Issues per stage and person (or project). Red = overdue part. Bug / Feedback narrows it.

qa.title: Issue lists
qa.text: Latest filed, Latest resolved and All issues. Any number above opens All issues narrowed to it. Edit in place, bulk edit and Excel export work as on Development.

kpi.title: Day, Week or Month
kpi.text: The period changes only the glowing data points: Closed, On-time, Project health (closed in the period) and People (delivered in the period), each compared with the period before. Open, On hold, Overdue, Projects and No deadline are counted as of now, whatever the period. Every task in every project, all departments. A task is closed when it first reaches QA Backlog (or, without QA stages, when Bitrix24 closes it).

kpi.title: Open tasks
kpi.text: Pending tasks: behind QA Backlog and not on hold. Department = the assignee’s department. Unassigned: those of them nobody has picked up yet (the placeholder assignee); click to list them. Click any count to list those tasks below.

kpi.title: Overdue
kpi.text: Open tasks whose deadline has passed. "Over 30 days" = more than 30 days late.

kpi.title: Closed
kpi.text: Tasks closed in the period (first QA Backlog, else the Bitrix24 closed date). Clean-ups of 30+ tasks closed in one project on one day are left out.

kpi.title: On-time
kpi.text: Of the tasks closed in the period that had a deadline, the share closed on or before it.

kpi.title: Projects
kpi.text: Every project active in Bitrix24, all departments (only the Project filter narrows it) = Active + Silent + Hold, the same rule as the Development Projects tile. Hold: every unfinished task is in On Hold. Active: open tasks and a task changed or moved in the last 30 days (bulk changes left out). Silent: the rest (no open task, or no activity for 30 days). Click the tile or a part to list those projects in Project health.

kpi.title: Tasks in hand
kpi.text: Open tasks whose deadline is still ahead (IST), by when they are planned: tomorrow, the rest of this week, the rest of this month, next week, next month. The parts overlap (tomorrow is also in the rest of the week), so they do not add up. Overdue and no-deadline tasks are counted in their own tiles. Click the tile for the planner: day, week or month columns per person (with the projects they work on) or per project (with who works on it), overdue first in red.

kpi.title: Tasks in hand by assignee
kpi.text: Open tasks with the deadline ahead, per assignee or project. The chart shows the window picked above it (All, Tomorrow, Rest of week, Rest of month, Next week, Next month); the table shows every window. A bar or count opens those tasks; a name sets the filter.

kpi.title: No deadline
kpi.text: Open tasks without a deadline: they cannot be overdue or planned.

kpi.title: Insights
kpi.text: Findings worked out from the same numbers. Click one to see its tasks. Start here each morning. Click the title to focus it in the centre; drag ⠿ at the top to move it.

kpi.title: Project health
kpi.text: One row per project, worst first. Red: over 25 % of open tasks overdue (at least 3), or a task over 30 days late. Amber: any overdue task, or silent. Green: neither.

kpi.title: Overdue breakdown
kpi.text: Open tasks past their deadline, by how many days late, per project and per person.

kpi.title: Workload
kpi.text: Open project tasks per person: overdue, due in the next 10 working days, due later, no deadline.

kpi.title: People
kpi.text: Per person: tasks closed in the period (vs the one before), on-time %, open and overdue now, QA send-backs on closed tasks, and closed tasks over the last 8 periods.

kpi.title: Activity
kpi.text: Busiest projects of the last 7 days: new tasks, bugs raised, stage moves and comments (ranked by new×2 + bugs×3 + moves + comments). Silent projects below.

kpi.title: All tasks
kpi.text: Every number on this tab opens its tasks here. Edit in place, bulk edit and Excel export work as on the other tabs.

insights.title: Insights
insights.text: What is holding us back, worked out from Bitrix24 data. 7, 14 or 30 days sets how far back activity is looked at: it changes the glowing data points (lagging projects and people, has room, the findings, projects, load and pulls). Overload, people split across projects and the release plan are counted as of now.
insights.member: What is holding your work back. 7, 14 or 30 days sets how far back your activity is looked at: it changes the glowing data points; overload, split work and the release plan are as of now.

insights.title: At a glance
insights.text: Lagging projects and people, the overloaded, those with room to help, people split across projects and releases at risk. Click a tile for the projects or people it counts, with why each is there; click one of them for its tasks.

insights.title: What is holding us back
insights.text: The findings ranked, causes first: a project taking people’s time while another project’s tasks go overdue, then lagging projects and people, overload, people with room and risky releases. Click one for its tasks.
insights.member: Your findings ranked, causes first: a project taking your time while your tasks in another go overdue, then your late work and releases at risk. Click one for its tasks.

insights.title: Projects
insights.text: Open tasks per project with the overdue part; ⚠ marks a lagging project. Hover for why; click for the tasks.

insights.title: Load
insights.text: Open tasks per person: overdue, due in the next 5 working days and the rest. ▲ overloaded, ▽ has room to take tasks over.

insights.title: Projects pulling people away
insights.text: Who has open work in several projects, how much they do in each, and which project is taking their time while another goes overdue.

insights.title: Release plan
insights.text: Tasks due this week and next with their planned date, stage and risk of slipping. Click a row for the task.

insights.title: Leave and attendance
insights.text: From Infowan once connected: leave, late arrivals and early leaving, and the tasks and projects they put at risk. Until then insights use Bitrix24 data.

connections.title: Connections
connections.text: Where reports go and where leave comes from: Microsoft 365 mail, Slack and Infowan. Each shows whether it is connected, sends a test to you, and explains how to connect it.

mailing.title: New report
mailing.text: Design a performance report: when (daily, weekly, monthly, or when someone’s numbers are very poor or very good), who (by role or by name; each gets their own part), what (topics and questions) and how (mail with CC, Slack messages, Slack channels).

mailing.title: Your reports
mailing.text: New reports start in Preview: only admins get them, with the list of who would. Preview shows the mail as any person would get it; Send test sends it to you; Go live sends it to everyone on schedule. Last runs show what went out.

workflow.title: How work flows
workflow.text: A task moves left to right through the Kanban stages to LIVE. Each lane is a department: the PM or team lead plans it (To do), Development builds it (In progress, Pushed to Master, Merged to Development, Pending for QA), QA tests it (QA Backlog, In QA, Done, or Issue Raised to send it back) and Release puts it live. Solid arrows are the usual moves, red dashed ones QA sending work back. The band underneath shows what each stage counts as. Click a stage for details.

workflow.title: One stage
workflow.text: What the stage means, who acts there, where it moves on to, the board column names that mean it, and which numbers on the dashboard it feeds.

workflow.title: Who does what
workflow.text: Each department and the stages where the next step is theirs.

workflow.title: Edit the workflow (admins)
workflow.text: Admins change the stages: order, names, departments, what each counts as, its roles, column names and arrows, and the rework rule. Once saved, every number on every page counts with it. Every version is kept and can be restored.

projecttypes.title: Projects that differ
projecttypes.text: Most projects follow the full development flow to LIVE. Support desks, DevOps and personal projects use short boards (New › In progress › Finished), others skip the code or release stages. Their numbers follow the same rules, with fewer stages.

projecttypes.title: Projects by type
projecttypes.text: Each type with its rule and its projects. Every project shows its own columns and the stage each counts as; a column the workflow does not know is outlined in red. Admins set a project’s type by hand, map an unknown column to a stage, and edit the types.

dailyreport.title: Who has not planned or wrapped up
dailyreport.text: Everyone expected to post (Daily update on), and who has planned and wrapped up their day. Click Not planned or Not wrapped up to list them. Without full data access you see only your own days.

dailyreport.title: Who planned and wrapped up
dailyreport.text: One line per person and working day: when they posted, how many tasks they planned, and how many ended Done, WIP, Pending or On hold. Pick the dates, department and assignee above; Excel and PDF take the whole report.

dailyreport.title: Planned vs done
dailyreport.text: Open a person’s day for every task: on the plan or added in the evening, what was reported, where it is now, its stage, status, priority, tags and deadline, and its Kanban moves that day.

daily.title: Plan your day
daily.text: Open it from the Daily update icon in the dock: what carries over from your last plan (still pending or WIP), your overdue and due-today tasks, upcoming ones you can take on early, and those with no deadline (plan one and its deadline is set to today when you post). Change any task right in its row (stage, status, tags…), keep, remove or add, write a note and post it to the daily work update group on Slack. You can open it all day to see and change your plan.

daily.title: Wrap up your day
daily.text: In the evening from the same icon, or when you sign out, your plan comes back with each task Pending, WIP, Done or On hold (from its stage). Report one as Done to complete it in Bitrix24, add tasks you finished ahead, and work outside the plan becomes a Bitrix24 task assigned to you. Then it goes to the same Slack thread.

daily.title: My last 30 days
daily.text: Each day you posted: tasks planned, done, WIP and outside the plan. Open the Daily update any time from its icon in the dock on the right.

feedback.title: Tell us
feedback.text: An issue, an idea or a wish: about the dashboard, a page, a project or a person (only the ones you can see). Add screenshots (paste them with Ctrl+V), PDF, Excel or Word files, up to 5.

feedback.title: My feedback
feedback.text: What you sent, whether it has been reviewed, and the reply.

docs.title: Guides
docs.text: PDF guides for your level of access: the whole dashboard, and module by module. Only the pages you can open are in them.

faq.title: FAQs
faq.text: Answers to the questions people ask most, by topic. Search at the top.

finance.title: Cost to company
finance.text: Coming soon, for admins only. Tell us what it should show and which decisions it should help with.

org.title: The company at a glance
org.text: Departments, people, department heads and departments without a head, from Bitrix24. Click a tile to open the tree; drag ⠿ to rearrange them.

org.title: Company tree
org.text: Departments as in Bitrix24, each with its head and people; sub-departments sit under their parent. Click a department to open or close it; search finds a person or department and opens the way to it.

people.title: Who uses the dashboard
people.text: Employees, who is signed in, who is active right now and who has never signed in. Click a tile to list them; click again to show everyone.

people.title: People directory
people.text: Everyone with designation and department, what they can open (access areas), their dashboard status and sign-ins, when they were last active, and their open and overdue tasks. Search and filter above; Excel at the top right.

people.title: Edit people and departments
people.text: Admins: Edit on a row changes the person’s dashboard role (here) and their designation and departments (in Bitrix24). Manage departments adds, renames and moves departments and sets their heads in Bitrix24. Every change is confirmed first and logged.

access.title: Access permissions
access.text: Who may open which page and what they may do there. Pick a person or a department on the left.

access.title: Module by module
access.text: Every menu module with a master switch; open it for its pages (each with its own switch) and the permissions under them: data scope, editing, inboxes. Grey dots come from the role, blue from a department, teal from the person, amber are not saved yet; ↺ goes back to inherited. Save at the bottom.

access.title: Recent changes
access.text: Every change: who made it, for whom, what it was before.

support.title: The Support tab is coming
support.text: It will be built from what the support team and management need, so it starts by asking you.

support.title: Share your needs
support.text: Tick what you would like to see, how often you would use it, and describe your biggest problem today. Must have, should have or nice to have helps us plan.

support.title: My feedback
support.text: What you sent, and whether it has been reviewed. Only you, the admins and the Support lead see your entries.

support.title: Feedback inbox
support.text: Every entry from everyone. Filter New or Must have, open one to read it all, add a private note, mark it reviewed, or download all as Excel.

INFO.total: All tasks in the filters for the switch (Dev, Issues or both), Development department only.
INFO.pending: Behind QA Backlog and not on hold: To do, In progress, Pushed to Master, Merged to Development, Pending for QA, Issue Raised. A testing or re-testing task in Issue Raised is not pending. Unassigned: those of them nobody has picked up yet (the placeholder assignee); click to list them.
INFO.hold: In On Hold: neither pending nor completed. Pending + completed + on hold = total.
INFO.ready: In the Done stage, ready to go live.
INFO.overdue: Pending, not On Hold, and the deadline has passed.
INFO.inHand: Pending tasks (behind QA Backlog, not on hold) whose deadline is still ahead (IST). Under it, when they are planned: tomorrow, the rest of this week, the rest of this month, next week, next month. The parts overlap (tomorrow is also in the rest of the week), so they do not add up. Overdue and no-deadline tasks are not in hand. Click the tile for the planner: day, week or month columns per person (with the projects they work on) or per project (with who works on it), overdue first in red.
INFO.spill: Spill: the deadline was in the previous day, week or month (IST, weeks Monday to Sunday) and the task was not pushed to QA Backlog by its end (still pending or on hold, or completed later).
INFO.openNoDeadline: Open (pending, not on hold) with no deadline set in Bitrix24.
INFO.donePrev: Pushed to QA Backlog in the previous day, week or month (IST, weeks Monday to Sunday).
INFO.overduePeriod: Pending, not on hold, the deadline has passed and it fell in the current day, week or month (IST).
INFO.devProjects: Every project active in Bitrix24 whose owner is in the Development or QA Testing department, or a PM (fixed: the switch and filters do not change it; only the Project filter narrows it) = Active + Silent + Hold. Hold: every unfinished task is in On Hold. Active: open tasks and a task changed or moved in the last 30 days (bulk changes left out). Silent: the rest (no open task, or no activity for 30 days). Click for Projects at work, most active this week first, then the earliest deadline: open a project for who works on it. Its Day / Week / Month switch sets Done (previous period), Overdue (this period) and Spill (previous period).
INFO.inHandBy: Pending tasks with the deadline ahead, per assignee or project. The chart shows the window picked above it (All, Tomorrow, Rest of week, Rest of month, Next week, Next month); the table shows every window. A bar or count opens those tasks; a name sets the filter.
INFO.qaInHandBy: The testing team's pending tasks with the deadline ahead, per assignee or project. The chart shows the window picked above it; the table shows every window. A bar or count opens those tasks; a name sets the filter.
INFO.qaInHand: The QA Testing team's pending testing tasks whose deadline is still ahead (IST), by when they are planned: tomorrow, the rest of this week, the rest of this month, next week, next month. The parts overlap, so they do not add up. Click the tile for the planner: day, week or month columns per person (with the projects they work on) or per project (with who works on it), overdue first in red.
INFO.doneToday: Reached QA Backlog for the first time today (IST).
INFO.dueToday: Deadline is today (IST), in any stage except LIVE.
INFO.assigneeTable: Per person or project. Done = sent to QA (QA Backlog to LIVE). Comp. today = reached QA Backlog today.
INFO.colPending: Pending: any stage behind QA Backlog except On Hold, Issue Raised included (not for testing or re-testing tasks).
INFO.colDone: Completed: in QA Backlog, In QA, Done or LIVE.
INFO.colDueToday: Deadline is today, not yet LIVE.
INFO.colCompToday: Reached QA Backlog for the first time today.
INFO.colCompYesterday: Reached QA Backlog for the first time yesterday (IST).
INFO.pendingVsDone: Pending vs completed (QA Backlog, In QA, Done, LIVE) per person or project, top 15 by total. Tooltip splits Dev / Issues (Bug / Feedback on Issues).
INFO.ageing: Open tasks by days past deadline. On Hold counts here but not as Overdue.
INFO.ranking: Tasks sent to QA with a deadline. Ranked by on-time %, then average days early. Fewer than 3: not ranked.
INFO.matrix: Tasks per Kanban stage; the colour bar shows each stage total. The red part of a cell is overdue.
INFO.allTasks: Every task in the filters, or the number you clicked.
INFO.alerts: Overdue tasks, and tasks over 5 days in one stage (LIVE aside). QA stages name the tester or QA lead.
INFO.qaTotal: Every task tagged bug or feedback in the filters, whoever it is assigned to.
INFO.qaOpen: Open = pending: any stage behind QA Backlog except On Hold (Issue Raised included). Resolved = QA Backlog, In QA, Done or LIVE. On Hold is its own tile. The ring shows the resolved %. Unassigned: those of them nobody has picked up yet (the placeholder assignee); click to list them. Click the tile for the open issues by project: open a project for who filed them, and a creator for who has them, each with Pending and Overdue.
INFO.qaLastFiled: Latest day an issue was created, and how many that day. Click for that day by project: open a project for who filed its issues (bug and feedback), and a creator for who they went to.
INFO.qaLastResolved: Latest day issues were pushed to QA Backlog (a fix handed to QA), and how many that day.
INFO.qaRework: Issues QA sent back after testing: from QA Backlog, In QA or Done to Issue Raised, To do or In progress. Stage flow only.
INFO.issuesByAssignee: Open vs resolved, each split into bug and feedback (or the reverse), per person or project. Table: the assignee-wise table.
INFO.issuesByStage: Issues per stage and person (or project). Red = overdue part. Bug / Feedback narrows it.
INFO.testing: Tasks tagged testing or re-testing, or assigned to QA Testing. Late = pending past deadline. A testing or re-testing task in Issue Raised is "Issue raised": not pending, never late.
INFO.retest: Issues in QA Backlog or In QA, by who filed them. Oldest = days waiting.
INFO.issueAge: Open issues by days past deadline (same as task ageing). On Hold counts here.
INFO.rework: QA send-backs per person or project, split into bug and feedback, and the % of their issues sent back. First Issue Raised to To do is not counted.
INFO.issueTrend: Last 7 days (IST): bugs and feedback filed (created, light) and resolved (pushed to QA Backlog that day, dark). Pick one assignee or project, or see all.
INFO.latestFiled: Issues created on the Last filed date.
INFO.retestAwaited: Every task waiting for QA: in QA Backlog or In QA, split into dev tasks and issues (bug or feedback).
INFO.retestByGroup: Tasks and issues in QA Backlog and In QA per assignee or project. Every number opens its tasks.
INFO.latestResolved: Issues pushed to QA Backlog on the Last resolved date.
INFO.allIssues: Every bug or feedback in the filters, or the number you clicked.

KPI_INFO.tab: Every task in every project, all departments. A task is closed when it first reaches QA Backlog (or, without QA stages, when Bitrix24 closes it).
KPI_INFO.open: Pending tasks: behind QA Backlog and not on hold. Department = the assignee’s department. Unassigned: those of them nobody has picked up yet (the placeholder assignee); click to list them.
KPI_INFO.hold: In On Hold: neither pending nor completed. Pending + completed + on hold = total.
KPI_INFO.overdue: Open tasks whose deadline has passed. "Over 30 days" = more than 30 days late.
KPI_INFO.closed: Tasks closed in the period (first QA Backlog, else the Bitrix24 closed date). Clean-ups of 30+ tasks closed in one project on one day are left out.
KPI_INFO.onTime: Of the tasks closed in the period that had a deadline, the share closed on or before it.
KPI_INFO.inHandBy: Open tasks with the deadline ahead, per assignee or project. The chart shows the window picked above it (All, Tomorrow, Rest of week, Rest of month, Next week, Next month); the table shows every window. A bar or count opens those tasks; a name sets the filter.
KPI_INFO.inHand: Open tasks whose deadline is still ahead (IST), by when they are planned: tomorrow, the rest of this week, the rest of this month, next week, next month. The parts overlap (tomorrow is also in the rest of the week), so they do not add up. Overdue and no-deadline tasks are counted in their own tiles. Click the tile for the planner: day, week or month columns per person (with the projects they work on) or per project (with who works on it), overdue first in red.
KPI_INFO.active: Every project active in Bitrix24, all departments (only the Project filter narrows it) = Active + Silent + Hold, the same rule as the Development Projects tile. Hold: every unfinished task is in On Hold. Active: open tasks and a task changed or moved in the last 30 days (bulk changes left out). Silent: the rest (no open task, or no activity for 30 days). Click the tile or a part to list those projects in Project health.
KPI_INFO.noDeadline: Open tasks without a deadline: they cannot be overdue or planned.
KPI_INFO.projects: One row per project, worst first. Red: over 25 % of open tasks overdue (at least 3), or a task over 30 days late. Amber: any overdue task, or silent. Green: neither.
KPI_INFO.overdue2: Open tasks past their deadline, by how many days late, per project and per person.
KPI_INFO.workload: Open project tasks per person: overdue, due in the next 10 working days, due later, no deadline.
KPI_INFO.people: Per person: tasks closed in the period (vs the one before), on-time %, open and overdue now, QA send-backs on closed tasks, and closed tasks over the last 8 periods.
KPI_INFO.activity: Busiest projects of the last 7 days: new tasks, bugs raised, stage moves and comments (ranked by new×2 + bugs×3 + moves + comments). Silent projects below.
KPI_INFO.insights: Findings worked out from the same numbers. Click one to see its tasks.
KPI_INFO.workingTime: Working time: Monday to Friday, 09:30 to 18:30 IST, public holidays excluded.
